final: WITH m AS (SELECT o.mktnote AS pair, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), g AS (SELECT pair, AVG(net) AS a FROM m GROUP BY pair), b AS (SELECT AVG(net) AS bm FROM m) SELECT AVG(g.a) AS avg_of_avg_net_rate, AVG(g.a - b.bm) AS avg_excess FROM g, b WHERE g.a > b.bm
